n: On May 19, 1838, a hill in Daviess County, Missouri, called Spring Hill, is named Adam-ondi-Ahman. The Lord reveals it as the place where Adam—the “Ancient of Days” in Daniel’s vision—will come to meet his posterity before the Second Coming. Latter-day Saints understand this as a great council where Adam reports to Christ.

f.g: Joseph Smith never fully defined the term; it is often understood to mean something like “the place or land of God where Adam dwelt.”
